Moreover, it is the least favored by other applicants, making it the least risky option but also the least rewarding. As a risk-seeker, I am less interested in this option.

In conclusion, my ranking reflects a balance between the high rewards associated with my top choices and the likelihood of being matched, given my priorities and the preferences of other applicants. I am willing to take the risk of not being matched with y due to its high value and my top priority ranking there.
